reports.title: Custom Truck One Source, Inc. Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Results and Increases Full Year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA and SER Revenue Guidance

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: We are increasing our full year 2026 SER segment revenue and Adjusted EBITDA1, 4 guidance and raising our net rental fleet investment forecast to reflect record rental performance and sustained demand across our utility T&D end markets.
